metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Shoulder Blade Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve pain around the shoulder blades—no equipment needed!

A common cause of shoulder blade (scapula) pain is a buildup of weakness and tightness in the main muscles that support this area. These muscles include the rhomboids, upper trapezius, and levator scapulae.

This video will guide you through exercises that help lengthen and strengthen these key muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief. For best results, go through all the exercises and use the ones that provide the most relief.

Best of all, these exercises can be done at home and may offer fast pain relief—in as little as 30 seconds!

Watch now and quickly fix your shoulder blade pain!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:48 Rhomboid Slide
2:36 Doorway Lean
4:23 Thread the Needle
6:32 Lift-Off (Strengthening)
7:40 Shoulder Blade Pump (Strengthening)
